name: Ushibori (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Ushibori town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised letter V with two pointed ears.
history: Flag of the former town of Ushibori in Ibaraki Prefecture, dissolved on 2001-04-01.

features.role: Ushibori town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised letter V with two pointed ears
